Oil Prices Surge Amidst US-Iran Tensions and Strait of Hormuz Concerns

Global oil prices have climbed to near six-week highs, with the Indian crude basket exceeding $100 per barrel. This surge is attributed to escalating tensions between the United States and Iran, which have disrupted the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route. The conflict has fueled concerns about potential disruptions to global oil supply.
